asset_coordinate_mode: local meters; master placement marker supplies campus XY

reference_geometry_comparison.source: pre-existing single-object massing library manifest bounds
reference_geometry_comparison.interpretation: OSM outline and original massing spatial bounds are the same target and extent.

measured_dimensions.method: axis-aligned envelope of OSM outline using project-local conversion
measured_dimensions.uncertainty_m: approximately 0.5–1.0 from source geometry and local projection; not surveyed

height.basis: three visible storeys and shallow roof profile in official ULu image, scaled approximately against the road-facing OSM boundary chain (about 28.5 m).
height.note: Prior massing top at 16 m was an unverified generic height; no authoritative measured height located.

architecture.exterior: red-brown brick, 3 storeys, broad horizontal glazing bays with dark aluminum frames, pale horizontal masonry courses, white UNIVERSITY / LUTHERAN sign, vertical Fuel sign, shallow dark metal roof
architecture.roof: low-slope roof deck with dark coping and restrained stepped parapet; slope/height estimated
architecture.interior: schematic cafe and office at grade, offices at second floor, sanctuary and pews on third floor, fellowship hall in basement; room use source-backed, exact interior layout not verified

limitations: Exact interior partitions and furniture are illustrative.
Building height and parapet profile are estimates from photograph; no surveyed elevation or published building section found.
Window module counts beyond the official road-facing elevation are extrapolated around the other footprint edges.

street_frontage.selection_method: edge direction within about 26 degrees of the road and outward normal facing the nearest road segment
street_frontage.note: The frontage follows several short stepped segments in the source footprint; this choice places the cafe/sign elevation on the road-facing side.

asset_origin_note: Massing assets retain absolute campus coordinates in their mesh and are linked at identity; the reported anchor is the outline centroid for location reference.
